imports_counts_min.name: imports_counts_min
imports_counts_min.value: skills_inserted >= 0 AND items_inserted >= 0 AND grades_inserted >= 0 AND skipped >= 0

imports_counts_by_kind.name: imports_counts_by_kind
imports_counts_by_kind.value: (kind = 'conteudo' AND grades_inserted = 0) OR (kind = 'notas_explicacao' AND skills_inserted = 0 AND items_inserted = 0)

materials_body_by_kind.name: materials_body_by_kind
materials_body_by_kind.value: body IS NULL OR kind IN ('nota','markdown')

materials_body_required_nota.name: materials_body_required_nota
materials_body_required_nota.value: kind <> 'nota' OR body IS NOT NULL

material_skills_page_order.name: material_skills_page_order
material_skills_page_order.value: page_from IS NULL OR page_to IS NULL OR page_from <= page_to

plan_items_kind_by_block.name: plan_items_kind_by_block
plan_items_kind_by_block.value: kind = CASE block WHEN 1 THEN 'revisao_previa' WHEN 2 THEN 'materia_nova' WHEN 3 THEN 'reforco' WHEN 4 THEN 'cartoes' END

items_options_json_shape.name: items_options_json_shape
items_options_json_shape.value: options_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(options_json) AND json_array_length(options_json) = 4)

items_options_json_by_kind.name: items_options_json_by_kind
items_options_json_by_kind.value: (kind = 'multipla_escolha' AND options_json IS NOT NULL) OR kind = 'cartao' OR (kind = 'aberta' AND options_json IS NULL)

items_difficulty_range.name: items_difficulty_range
items_difficulty_range.value: difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 3

items_dimension_enum.name: items_dimension_enum
items_dimension_enum.value: dimension IS NULL OR dimension IN ('conceitual','fluencia','problemas','explicacao')

items_evidence_enum.name: items_evidence_enum
items_evidence_enum.value: evidence IS NULL OR evidence IN ('reconhecimento','interpretacao','representacao','discriminacao')

items_category_enum.name: items_category_enum
items_category_enum.value: category IS NULL OR category IN ('rotineira','nao_rotineira','transferencia')

items_expected_seconds_fluencia.name: items_expected_seconds_fluencia
items_expected_seconds_fluencia.value: expected_seconds IS NULL OR (COALESCE(dimension, '') = 'fluencia' AND expected_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 3600)

review_logs_grade_range.name: review_logs_grade_range
review_logs_grade_range.value: grade IS NULL OR grade BETWEEN 1 AND 4

review_logs_attempt_range.name: review_logs_attempt_range
review_logs_attempt_range.value: attempt IS NULL OR attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 3
